FixtureType.Description: Generic halogen profile spot on a dimmer channel - 1ch Dimmer plus a VIRTUAL Zoom. Authored for this project (ADR-0037, ADR-0038 rule 5). BeamAngle equals FieldAngle, which is the hard-edge degeneration a profile is the fixture for. The Zoom channel has Offset='' - it exists logically and consumes no DMX slot, because the barrel is set by hand at hang time; its value comes from the per-fixture override (ADR-0037 decision 7), and gdtf-ts must implement virtual channels for it to resolve at all. PLACEHOLDER, per ADR-0037 decision 8: the halogen 3200 K is the standard theatre figure and NOT a measurement; the 25-50 degree zoom range is the fixture's nominal spec and is UNVERIFIED against these two units; the body dimensions are nominal. The two units are hung at 30 and 42 degrees - those are hang settings and live in the per-fixture override, never in this file. BeamRadius is deliberately OMITTED - no lens dimension is known, so it falls to the GDTF default rather than to an invented number. CRI 100 and the black-body 3200 K are tungsten-halogen physics.
